title: 1828 Sanjō earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1828 Sanjō earthquake", at revision 1360346223, opens: "The 1828 Sanjō earthquake occurred on December 18, 1828 at Sanjo, Niigata Prefecture in Japan. According to the official report, 21,134 houses and buildings were damaged, and 1,204 of them burned down. There were around 1,450 casualties." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11355824, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Earthquake in Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
